snippet.title: RITA  - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam! 🐤🧩🧡 https://store.steampowered.com/app/2984850/Rita/

Rita is a cosy-casual-puzzle-adventure game. Play as a chicklet named Rita, and make your way by solving word puzzles in the newspaper. There will be NPC side-quests, hidden puzzles, and light platforming along the way. Nothing too stressful as you unlock Rita's story and her little world.

#indiedev #indiegame #godotengine #godot #puzzlegame #adventuregame #crossword #cosygames
